name: SoldComps
description: eBay sold-comps API for resellers and analysts — one keyword returns up to 200 completed sales with real prices, conditions, and dates.

mentions.evidence: ~$18.8k MRR, 488 active subscriptions, ~$18.8k L30, ~$38.1k all-time, founded Mar 2025, Canada. Last sync Sep 30, 2026.
mentions.indieAngle: Wrap a marketplace's awkward public data into a paid API — same shape as ControlResell ops, but for pricing intel.

whyItPrints: Resellers live on sold comps. eBay's own APIs are restricted/messy; SoldComps sells clean access at $9–$79/mo. Pure data plumbing for a sweaty niche.
